note:
Recover the 30B MoE point of the model-scale axis, which the ledger currently marks
UNUSABLE.

Every previous 30B run used --expert-model-parallel-size 2 and produced degenerate
repetition before the first optimizer step, so its mis_kl measured the repetition rather than
any quantization effect (h200_results/P2R_30B_INVALID.md). The standalone probe has since
shown the cause: expert parallelism. EP=1 generates correctly at TP 1, 4 and 8, and EP>1
fails at every TP tried (moe_probe/README.md).

So run 30B with EP=1 and see whether the sanity screens pass this time. If they do, the
model-scale axis gets its third point (4B and 8B dense, plus 30B MoE) and the 30B mis_kl
becomes quotable. If they do not, something beyond EP is involved and the ledger entry
stands.

Sizing: TP=8 on one node rather than TP=4/EP=2 across two, because the probe measured
TP8/EP1 as healthy and a single node removes the cross-node variable entirely. 30B bf16 is
about 61GB, which fits 8x143GB with room for the trainer.

First attempt at TP=8 on one node died with CUDA OOM in MegatronTrainRayActor.init: each rank tried to allocate 108.76 GiB against 139.80 GiB of capacity. That is the point -- with EP=1 every rank holds all 128 experts, whereas EP=2 gives each rank 64. So EP is not merely a performance knob here; dropping it to 1 to avoid the repetition bug costs memory that a single node does not have. Retrying across 2 nodes with TP=16.

cells.name: 30b_ep1_bf16
cells.note:
30B MoE, EP=1, bf16 KV. The screens to watch are the same three the ledger uses:
repetition_frac <= 0.05, mis_ppl_ratio <= 1.5, raw_reward > 0. The EP=2 runs failed all three
(0.633 / 1.78 / 0.0).

TP=16 across 2 nodes because EP=1 replicates all 128 experts per rank and TP=8 on one node ran out of memory (108.76 GiB requested per rank).

Third attempt: TP=8 PP=2. TP=16 requested the same 108 GiB as TP=8, so tensor parallelism does not split the expert weights -- only EP and PP can. PP=2 halves the layers each rank holds, and with 48 layers that is 24 each, so the expert footprint should halve too. mem-fraction drops to 0.5 to leave the trainer room.

comparisons_note: No paired comparison here: this is a single cell asking whether the sanity screens pass at all. The contrast is against the ledger's existing 30B entries, which were run with EP=2 under a different recipe and are recorded as UNUSABLE rather than as a comparison arm.
